verdict.rationale: Firebase documents its own ways to operate the product in natural language. The official MCP server lets AI clients such as Claude Code, Cursor and VS Code Copilot create and manage projects, manage Auth users, and work with Firestore and SQL Connect data. Gemini in Firebase adds a natural-language chat interface in the console, which can also generate schemas, queries and mutations on demand. missing for 10: evidence that the console's Gemini chat executes operations directly rather than only answering questions and generating code, documentation of how far MCP covers operations beyond projects, Auth and data, and any independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works in practice.
